tool_calls.literal: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' README.md; jq -r '[.value, (.stack_frames[] | select(startswith(\"action:\"))), (.stack_frames[] | select(startswith(\"strategy:\"))), (.stack_frames[] | select(startswith(\"result:\")))] | @tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{k="'$2"'"\\t\""'$3"'"\\t\""'$4; s[k]+=$1} END {for(k in s) print s[k],k}'"' | sort -nr | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "jq -r '[.value, (.stack_frames[]|select(startswith(\"result:\"))), (.stack_frames[]|select(startswith(\"action:\"))), .labels.source_session[0]]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '"'$2=="result:repeated" {if($1>0){p+=$1; ps[$4]=1; pa[$3]+=$1}else{n+=-$1; ns[$4]=1; na[$3]+=-$1}} END {for(x in ps) pc++; for(x in ns) nc++; print "positive_repeated",p,"sessions",pc; print "negative_repeated",n,"sessions",nc; print "net",p-n; for(a in pa) print a,"positive",pa[a],"negative",na[a]+0,"net",pa[a]-na[a]}'"' | sort -k1,1 -k2,2nr; jq -r '[.value, (.stack_frames[]|select(startswith(\"result:\")))]|@tsv' samples.jsonl | awk -F '\\t' '{if("'$1>0){p[$2]+=$1; tp+=$1}else{n[$2]+=-$1;tn+=-$1}} END {print "all_positive",tp,"all_negative",tn; for(k in p) print k,p[k],n[k]+0,p[k]-n[k]}'"' | sort -k4,4nr | head -20"
